evidence.quote: the Federal Reserve has done, and will continue to do, everything possible within the limits of its authority to assist in restoring our nation to financial stability and economic prosperity as quickly as possible.
we see little risk of unacceptably high inflation in the near term; indeed, we expect inflation to be quite low for some time.
the recent economic statistics have been dismal, with many economies, including ours, having fallen into recession.
Last week, in conjunction with the Treasury, we announced that we were prepared to expand significantly this facility, known as the Term Asset-Backed Securities Loan Facility, or TALF
at some point, when credit markets and the economy have begun to recover, the Federal Reserve will have to moderate growth in the money supply and begin to raise the federal funds rate.

parsed.rationale: The speech describes a dismal recession, very low expected inflation, and ongoing and expanding credit-easing programs, with a commitment to do everything possible. Discussion of the eventual exit is conditional on recovery and mainly serves to reassure about inflation risks, so the net signal is strongly dovish.
